snapshot_note: Rules that four MDPI journals' Instructions for Authors pages state word for word (IJMS, Cancers, Molecules, Applied Sciences). The abstract, the main-text section order, whether Conclusions or a Simple Summary are required, and figure resolution differ by journal: SubmitReady reads those from the journal's own page on every run.

csl_style.title: Multidisciplinary Digital Publishing Institute
csl_style.note: The style the instructions link for Zotero. Many MDPI journals also have a dependent style of the same parent.

requirements.rule: Three to ten keywords after the abstract
requirements.quote: Three to ten pertinent keywords need to be added after the abstract.

requirements.rule: Back matter in this order: Supplementary Materials, Author Contributions, Funding, Data Availability Statement, Acknowledgments, Conflicts of Interest, References
requirements.quote: Back matter: Supplementary Materials, Author Contributions, Funding, Data Availability Statement, Acknowledgments, Conflicts of Interest, References.

requirements.rule: Author Contributions paragraph with CRediT roles
requirements.quote: For research articles with several authors, a short paragraph specifying their individual contributions must be provided.

requirements.rule: Funding section: all sources, grants and any funds for publication costs
requirements.quote: All sources of funding of the study should be disclosed.

requirements.rule: Data Availability Statement, even when no new data were made
requirements.quote: It is mandatory for the authors to include a “Data Availability Statement (DAS)” section in their manuscripts
If there is no conflict of interest, please state

requirements.rule: Institutional Review Board and Informed Consent statements for studies with humans or animals
requirements.quote: In this section, please add the Institutional Review Board Statement and approval number for studies involving humans or animals.

requirements.rule: Reference numbers in square brackets, before the punctuation, e.g. [1], [1–3] or [1,3]
requirements.quote: In the text, reference numbers should be placed in square brackets [ ], and placed before the punctuation; for example [1], [1–3] or [1,3].

requirements.rule: Figures, schemes and tables go in the main text close to their first citation, numbered in order of appearance
requirements.quote: inserted into the main text close to their first citation

requirements.rule: Figures are inserted in the manuscript file
requirements.quote: inserted into the main text close to their first citation

requirements.rule: Supplementary items named like 'Figure S1: title, Table S1: title'
requirements.quote: Please indicate the name and title of each element as follows Figure S1: title, Table S1: title, etc.

requirements.rule: Generative AI use: in Methods how it was used, and in Acknowledgments the tool, version and purpose
requirements.quote: Where applicable, authors are required to disclose in this section details of how GenAI has been used in the paper

requirements.rule: Acronyms defined at first use in the abstract, the main text and the first figure or table
requirements.quote: should be defined the first time they appear in each of three sections: the abstract; the main text; the first figure or table.
Equations should be editable by the editorial office and not appear in a picture format.

requirements.rule: All files together at most 120 MB
requirements.quote: The total amount of data for all files must not exceed 120 MB.

requirements.rule: Original, uncropped blot, gel and microscopy images may be requested: at least 1000 pixels or 300 dpi
requirements.quote: a minimum of 1000 pixels in width/height, or a resolution of 300 dpi or higher

requirements.rule: Read on the journal's own page: abstract length and headings, main-text section order, whether Conclusions or a Simple Summary are required, and figure resolution
